newsitem.title: USA: Bradlees names Peter Thorner CEO.
newsitem.headline: Bradlees names Peter Thorner CEO.

text.p: Bradlees Inc., the retailer struggling to reorganize and emerge from bankruptcy proceedings, said Tuesday its board named Peter Thorner chairman and chief executive officer, effective immediately.
Thorner will succeed Mark Cohen, who has resigned, the Braintree, Mass.-based retailer said.

Bradlees, which is operating under Chapter 11 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code, has been closing stores as it tries to cut costs and return to financial health. In Chapter 11 a company is protected from its creditors as it tries to work out a plan to pay its debts.
Bradlees said Thorner became president and chief operating officer in June 1995 and a member of the board of directors the following month.
Bradlees operates 110 discount department stores in Maine, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
